ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark pigmentation covering >95% of the surface area; localized high-contrast white pixel clusters at the lateral extremities (tips) of both lobes and a single isolated circular white spot on the upper-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with a deep vertex, dividing the two lobes symmetrically.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration along the continuous trailing boundary; the right lobe shows higher-amplitude jaggedness and pixel-level variation towards the tip compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering toward the lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular high-contrast clusters (barnacles) at both distal tips; one distinct isolated circular high-contrast pixel group located on the mid-upper section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the far-left and far-right lateral margins of the fluke lobes.
